roadmap.note: One trophy can disappear. At Jason's house, after Lucia mentions meditation in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and accept the prompt. That is the only spot that goes away when Chapter 1 ends.

roadmap.note: Story missions and stranger finales come in order. Work each stranger chain as soon as it unlocks — some have windows tied to story progress.
roadmap.title: Story — the 17

roadmap.note: Finish 8 full stranger mission strands across Leonida. Do Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 when it appears — it may count toward this trophy.
roadmap.title: Strangers — 8 strands

roadmap.note: The grind phase: 250 stunts, 42 gold range medals, 14 drone races, 20 races, 100 WAiNK spots, 50 challenges, 100 vehicles, 5 vaults, 52 areas, 9 gangs, 500 profile actions, $250,000 laundered, $100,000 spent, 8 garages, 10 Scooter Bros registrations.

roadmap.note: Sample each activity once, beat Cal at fishing, finish an arcade game, hunt Bret's animal, complete 3 card sets, lose a 4-star with your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back, 5 takedowns in one Combat Focus, the VCIA departure, the Rhinos, a stealth jewelry job, an armored truck, the bowling alley job, and max Strength on Jason and Lucia.
